_comment: Baked to /home/node/.claude/settings.json. Claude Code rewrites this file
for its own keys (skipDangerousModePermissionPrompt after the first bypass
run; extraKnownMarketplaces and enabledPlugins when a plugin is installed),
so it is COPIED BEFORE the plugin install in the Dockerfile — the installer
merges into it. Copying afterwards would drop enabledPlugins and the plugin
The hooks below are ours, not the LangSmith plugin's: the plugin brings its
own hooks/hooks.json and needs nothing here. See graders/session-stamp.mjs.
UserPromptSubmit fires first and unconditionally, which is what makes the
stamp reliable; SubagentStop is the only place a delegated turn's separate
transcript path is ever reported; SessionEnd catches the final state.
